hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for prediction market pools that implements VALS (Volatility-Adjusted Liquidity Sensitivity) fees. Each swap requires a backend-signed sigma parameter; the hook computes an exponential fee based on trade size, pool liquidity, and toxic velocity, then captures the fee via BeforeSwapDelta and routes it to a YieldDistributor for share holders rather than LPs.
